Job Summary**

Responsible for the safe and efficient delivery of eggs from the farm to designated locations using a company-provided egg van, ensuring product quality and timely distribution.

Job Responsibilities**

* Load and unload egg products from the farm and deliver to various distribution points or customers.
* Operate and maintain the egg van in a safe and responsible manner, adhering to all traffic laws and company policies.
* Conduct pre-trip and post-trip inspections of the vehicle, reporting any maintenance issues or damage promptly.
* Ensure the proper handling and storage of eggs to maintain quality and prevent damage during transit.
* Verify quantities and types of eggs being transported against delivery manifests.
* Maintain accurate delivery records and obtain necessary signatures for proof of delivery.
* Communicate effectively with farm staff, dispatch, and customers regarding delivery schedules and any issues.
* Adhere to all food safety and hygiene regulations relevant to egg transportation.
* Assist with basic cleaning and maintenance of the vehicle as required.

Job Qualifications**

* Valid Class B (HC) driver's license with a clean driving record.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience as a delivery driver, preferably with experience in transporting fragile goods.
* Knowledge of local routes in the Bati-Bati area and surrounding regions.
* Ability to lift and carry heavy loads (e.g., egg crates) repeatedly throughout the day.
* Strong sense of responsibility and attention to detail.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage time effectively.
* Familiarity with basic vehicle maintenance and safety procedures.
* High school diploma or equivalent.

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.
